patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...) Download the patch from the link below Extract the contents of the patch archive into the game install folder mentioned above It's working if: When you service the man at the top of the first village for money, there is no white smoke covering any sensitive areas. uncensorpat.ch checked this patch on PC.
